summary.plain: A set of different kinds of ground detectors on a Chinese mountain, working together to sense cosmic-ray and gamma-ray showers in several ways at once.
summary.technical: Multi-component air-shower array at 4410 m on Haizi Mountain, Sichuan, China. Sub-array names/specifications (KM2A/WCDA/WFCTA unit counts) are not recorded here: no source fetched this session gave them (the IHEP site's technical pages render as empty JavaScript shells under WebFetch).

technology.note: The individual KM2A (electromagnetic/muon), WCDA (water Cherenkov) and WFCTA (wide-field Cherenkov telescope) sub-array names are public knowledge of the LHAASO design but their specifications (unit counts, per-component areas) were not confirmed by a source fetched this session; not asserted here as sourced facts.
technology.value: Multi-component extensive-air-shower detector combining different shower-sampling techniques (electron, muon and Cherenkov/fluorescence light) at one high-altitude site.
